verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for automatically choosing the best model per task. What it does show is related but different: per-mode model packs with failover to a fallback pack when provider accounts are rate-limited or down, and manual model switching mid-conversation. Neither selects a model based on the task, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the tool automatically pick the best model for each task
